import gzip,hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
p=Path('evaluation/evidence/reviews/a2-parser-fixes-20261106')
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
rows=json.loads((p/'commands.json').read_text())
assert len(rows)==8
for row in rows:
 expected=1 if row['log'].endswith('/baseline-probes.txt.gz') else 0
 assert row['exitCode']==expected and not row['timedOut'],row
 packed=Path(row['log']).read_bytes()
 assert sha(packed)==row['compressedSha256']
 assert sha(gzip.decompress(packed))==row['outputSha256']
read=lambda name:gzip.decompress((p/(name+'.txt.gz')).read_bytes()).decode()
assert 'AssertionError' in read('baseline-probes')
assert '153 passed in 14.16s' in read('focused-tests')
mutation=read('rpc-mutants')
assert 'control: unmutated module passes all tests' in mutation
assert 'detected 32 of 32' in mutation and len(re.findall(r'^DETECTED ',mutation,re.M))==32
assert not re.search(r'NOT-DETECTED|INVALID|CONTROL FAILED',mutation)
assert read('exports').strip()=='exports match 9 files'
sel=json.loads((p/'focused-selection.json').read_text())
assert len(sel['selected'])==153 and not sel['excludedLiveFixture']
assert sum('test_rpc_binding_view.py::' in n for n in sel['selected'])==47
assert sum('test_binding_open.py::' in n for n in sel['selected'])==106
before=json.loads((p/'inputs-before.json').read_text())
after=json.loads((p/'source-after.json').read_text())
assert after['sourceEntriesUnchanged']==len(before['sourcePins'])==438
assert after['localInputsUnchanged']==len(before['localInputs'])==248
for name,digest in before['helperPins'].items():assert sha((p/name).read_bytes())==digest
old=json.loads((p/'probes-before.json').read_text());new=json.loads((p/'probes.json').read_text())
assert old['controlCount']==new['controlCount']==15
assert old['propertyProbeCount']==new['propertyProbeCount']==12
assert len(old['acceptanceGaps'])==8 and not new['acceptanceGaps']
for a,b in zip(old['rows'],new['rows'],strict=True):
 assert a['label']==b['label'] and a['rawReply']==b['rawReply']
 assert b['expected']==b['actual']
 if a['classification']=='control':assert a['actual']==b['actual'] and a['returned']==b['returned']
peer=json.loads((p/'communication-provenance-final.json').read_text())
assert not peer['missingBranches']
assert not any(r['ambiguous'] or r['divergentRevisions'] for r in peer['files'].values())
assert peer['branches']==before['branches']
delta=json.loads((p/'delta-review.json').read_text())
assert sha((p/'reviewed-owner-delta.patch').read_bytes())==delta['patchSha256']
assert len(delta['changedPaths'])==12
assert before['deltaProvenance']['protocol/hmbc_protocol/rpc_binding_view.py']['fileChangingCommit']==delta['runtimeFileChangingCommit']
locks=json.loads((p/'lock-check.json').read_text())
for name,row in locks['locks'].items():
 assert row['independentlyBlockedWhileHeld']
 assert (Path('.git')/name).stat().st_ino==row['inode']
result=dict(recordedAt=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),commandsVerified=8,
 sourceCommit=before['sourceCommit'],sourceEntries=438,localInputs=248,helpers=4,
 focusedPass=153,rpcTests=47,bindingOpenTests=106,isolatedMutationControls=32,
 independentControls=15,refusalProperties=12,baselineGaps=8,fixedGaps=0,
 defaultExportFiles=9,communicationPaths=len(peer['files']),peerBranches=peer['branches'],
 ownerRuntimeReady=False,ownerLiveResultsIndependentlyRerun=False,
 fullOwnerOrRootSuiteRerun=False,executionAuthorized=False,fGate='NOT_RUN',gGate='LOCKED',
 immutableChecks=after,inventorySha256=sha((p/'inputs-before.json').read_bytes()),
 sourceAfterSha256=sha((p/'source-after.json').read_bytes()),probesSha256=sha((p/'probes.json').read_bytes()),
 baselineProbesSha256=sha((p/'probes-before.json').read_bytes()),patchSha256=delta['patchSha256'])
(p/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
